title: SubstrateAgentManifest
description: Schema definition for third-party AI Agent manifests connecting to Personal Agent Substrate.

manifest_version.description: Version of the manifest specification format. Must be 1.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identifier for the agent (e.g. org.agent.researcher).

name.description: Human-readable display name of the agent.

version.description: Semantic version of the agent software.

description.description: Brief description of the agent's responsibilities and capabilities.

homepage.description: URL to the agent's homepage or repository.

capabilities_requested.description: List of capabilities declared by the agent requiring user permission.

capability.description: Capability identifier string, e.g. demo.note.read, memory.read, system.notify.

scope.description: Scope delimiter for capability constraint, e.g. synthetic.welcome, agent_owned, *.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation shown to the user on authorization prompt.

required.description: Whether the agent requires this capability to operate.

max_concurrent_tasks.description: Maximum number of simultaneous tasks the agent requests to process.

data_retention_policy.description: Policy describing agent-side caching or retention of decrypted personal data.
